t: Making a Crabby Tide Pool Aquarium in New England!
d: Mark builds a tide pool aquarium along the New England coast and fills it with crabs and marine critters. It's hands-on science at its best.The vampire fish lives up to its name. Coyote gets bitten and shows the terrifying teeth and feeding behavior of this river predator.

The sea lamprey is a nightmare with a mouth full of teeth. Coyote experiences what it's like to be eaten alive—literally.Coyote explores a recently abandoned grizzly bear cave, uncovering signs of the massive predator's presence in a thrilling and suspenseful wilderness episode.

t: Area 51 Plane Crash – We Found It!
d: Mark explores a remote crash site in the desert rumored to be tied to Area 51. What he finds is strange, twisted, and possibly historic.Man O' War jellyfish are not true jellyfish—but they're still deadly. Mark gets stung and showcases their long, venomous tentacles.
Coyote uncovers T-Rex teeth during a fossil hunt. Rare, real, and awe-inspiring, this one's for the dino lovers.

t: Will It Bite?! – Giant Bloodsucking Parasite!
d: A giant bloodsucking parasite—will it bite? Coyote takes the risk to learn how these creatures latch onto hosts and extract blood.

t: My Precious! – Coyote Goes Full Gollum!
d: Channeling his inner Gollum, Coyote becomes obsessed with a strange find in the wild. This lighthearted episode brings out his wildest side.

Coyote blends poison ivy into a smoothie to test a myth. Spoiler: bad idea. This wild episode mixes humor with a powerful message about plant toxicity.Roaches take over—literally. Coyote faces a nightmare infestation right on his head, exploring how these pests behave and thrive in close quarters.

t: Stung by a Venomous Neon Caterpillar!
d: The neon caterpillar's venom isn't just a defense—it's a chemical marvel. Coyote experiences its sting firsthand.Who's faster—Coyote or the world's fastest animal? He sets up a high-stakes race to test reflexes, speed, and a bit of humility.
Coyote faces manys fear... Getting a tatoo!Caring for a miniature pony is no small job! Coyote visits a farm and learns the basics of grooming, feeding, and why these tiny horses need special care.

t: Snapping Turtle vs. Hand: Will It Break?!
d: Snapping turtles are no joke, but can they actually break bone? Coyote puts his own hand (and nerves) on the line to find out.The stinging nettle may look harmless, but it hides a nasty surprise. Coyote experiences the sting and explains its effects and remedies.

t: Insane Urban Beehive Extraction – You Won't Believe This!
d: Urban beekeeping gets extreme as Coyote removes a huge hive from a populated area. Flying stings and swarming bees make it a wild ride.What does a snake bite look like in slow motion? Coyote captures the full strike in ultra-HD to showcase precision and danger.

t: Lake Erie Monster – Is It Real?!
d: Is the Lake Erie Monster real? Coyote dives into folklore, interviews, and lake searches to investigate the mystery behind the legend.Chiggers are tiny but brutal. Coyote takes one for the team to show what their bites look like and how to avoid the fiery aftermath.

t: What Did I Find?! – Dissecting Snowy Owl Pellets!
d: Coyote dissects snowy owl pellets to uncover the tiny skeletons inside. This educational episode reveals what owls eat and how they digest it.Coyote challenges a tortoise to an all-you-can-eat green bean buffet. Hilarity ensues as the slow-and-steady eater powers through a feast.
